collection.description: A child asks why a familiar villager now wears clothes usually associated with another gender.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why (villager) now wears clothes usually associated with another gender.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) says clothing can express comfort and personal style.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks whether anyone may choose colors they like.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a teacher, explains that clothing traditions differ across families.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) discovers that customs can change over time.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) compliments the garment without making assumptions.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) learns not to tease someone for dressing differently.
